purpose: Single source of truth for the books that ground Synapse and for the engineering decisions Synapse made on its own. Lessons are translated into contracts; no book text is copied.
rule: Every book and every own implementation must list where it is applied; tests check the paths exist and that docs/books/implementation_map.md covers every entry.
paths_relative_to: the Synapse repository; generated projects receive only the artifacts of their universe

books.title: AI Engineering
books.lessons: evals before optimization; product metrics; cost/latency tradeoffs; RAG vs fine-tuning; dataset engineering; feedback loops

books.title: Designing Machine Learning Systems
books.lessons: data contracts, baselines, model cards, monitoring, drift and continual learning

books.title: Foundations of Machine Learning - Lecture Notes

books.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning

books.title: Prompt Engineering for LLMs

books.title: LLM Engineer's Handbook
books.lessons: feature/ingestion pipelines into vector databases, SFT, preference alignment, parameter-efficient training, LLMOps

books.title: Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)

books.title: Building LLMs for Production

books.title: The Society of Mind

books.title: Cybernetics: Or Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine

books.title: Building Applications with AI Agents

books.title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence

own_implementations.decision: Dialog-first project factory with four universes, briefing gate, rollback and per-universe artifact alignment
Keyword-scored archetypes, effective universe with confirmation, ADR in JSON and Markdown
Scenario-based framework and technology catalog with templates vs scaffold targets
Deterministic treatment (missing, duplicates, IQR and z-score outlier flags, rare categories) with thresholds in policy
Local regression/classification/forecasting baselines with a JSON model registry
LLM-free eval suites: prompt contracts, faithfulness by grounding in the cited source, hybrid retrieval recall/MRR/nDCG
Context filter before LLM calls and market radar for tooling signals
Local SQLite MCP mailbox shared by Codex, Claude Code and humans
Single assistant per task, workflow roles, request profiles with model tier and token budget
Scale tiers, vector DB catalog, HNSW/IVF parameters, reciprocal rank fusion (k=60, information-retrieval literature), hashing embedder, blue/green index versions
Pilot/production minimums (50/500), 5% gain over baseline, human score 0.8, leakage-free hash split
Harness components per universe, loop limits, pass@k/pass^k reliability metrics (agent benchmark practice), governance migrated from the former trust framework
Runtime agent blueprints derived from the ADR, owner roles, tools never invented, approval for external actions
14-stage state machine, explicit risk thresholds (100k/1M, regulated = CRITICAL, missing factor = HIGH), prioritization weights
Phantom-reference guard, stdlib-only analyzer and engines, validator that blocks swarm/fleet regressions
